hooks.text: The longest phantom planet hunt in history lasted over fifty years.
For fifty-six years, astronomers tracked a phantom planet named Vulcan.
Astronomers won medals discovering a planet that did not exist.

title: The 50-Year Hunt for a Phantom Planet
description: For over fifty years, astronomers hunted a phantom world named Vulcan inside Mercury's orbit until Einstein proved space itself was warping.

beats.text: The longest phantom planet hunt in history lasted over fifty years.
beats.visual: Artist's illustration of hypothetical planet Vulcan orbiting near the Sun

beats.text: In 1859, [Urbain Le Verrier](/ˈɜɹbˈænlˈʌvˈAɹˈiˈI/) noticed Mercury straying from its path by 43 arcseconds per century.
beats.visual: Diagram showing the perihelion precession of Mercury's orbit around the Sun

beats.text: Having already predicted Neptune through gravitational math, he deduced an unseen world inside Mercury's orbit was tugging it.
beats.visual: Portrait painting of French mathematician Urbain Le Verrier

beats.text: Soon, an amateur observer reported its transit across the Sun, earning the Legion of Honor for discovering Vulcan.
beats.visual: Silhouette transit across the glowing disk of the Sun
queries: Transit of Mercury solar disc SDO

card.small: named for the Roman god of fire

beats.text: Expeditions chased total solar eclipses, and professional astronomers even reported spotting the blazing world.
beats.visual: Astronomers observing the total solar eclipse of July 29, 1878 in Wyoming

beats.text: Then in 1915, Albert Einstein plugged Mercury into his brand-new theory of general relativity.
beats.visual: Formal portrait photograph of physicist Albert Einstein, circa 1916

beats.text: The Sun's mass was warping spacetime itself, giving Einstein heart palpitations when his math matched Mercury without any extra planet.
beats.visual: Diagram illustrating the curvature of spacetime around the Sun's mass

beats.text: Space was bending, proving mankind had spent half a century chasing a ghost.
beats.visual: Vintage astronomical star chart showing the inner solar system orbits
queries: Inner solar system orbits antique diagram
